label: Time to complete a standardized task
operational_definition: Elapsed seconds from task instruction to saved output verified against the checklist
denominator: One standardized task per unit at each timepoint

label: Required record fields completed
operational_definition: All prespecified required fields present and valid for the eligible record
denominator: One eligible record per unit at each timepoint

label: Follow-up correctly flagged for action
operational_definition: Eligible follow-up is correctly identified as needing action within the prespecified window
denominator: One eligible follow-up per unit at each timepoint

label: Overall user satisfaction
operational_definition: Approved satisfaction instrument composite or item, scored using its prespecified rubric
denominator: One respondent per unit at each timepoint
